provider: google artifact registry (as a blob store)

free_tier.stated: 0.5 GiB-month of Artifact Registry storage free per billing account, shared across every project attached to it; above that USD 0.000136986 per GiB-hour
free_tier.notes: the Google Cloud Free Tier page states the same allowance as 0.5 GB of storage per month

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the Artifact Registry quotas page lists request quotas and usage limits but no size cap for a stored file
per_object_cap.notes: the only size limit on the quotas page is 9.9 GB of data retrieved from the upstream of a remote repository per request

retention.stated: unverified: the pricing, quotas and generic artifact pages state no expiry for stored artifacts
retention.notes: cleanup policies, at most 10 per repository, delete at most 300,000 artifacts per repository a day

egress.terms: outbound internet transfer from a repository is billed at Premium Tier internet rates; transfer into Google Cloud is free; transfer to a Google Cloud service in the same location is free, and between locations in the US and Canada it is USD 0.01 per GiB; no free outbound allowance is stated for Artifact…

interface_detail: generic repositories: upload with POST https://artifactregistry.googleapis.com/upload/v1/projects/PROJECT/locations/LOCATION/repositories/REPOSITORY/genericArtifacts:create, download with GET https://artifactregistry.googleapis.com/download/v1/projects/PROJECT/locations/LOCATION/repositories/REPOSITORY/files/FILE:download?alt=media, or gcloud artifacts generic upload and download; Docker-format repositories store OCI images
tooling: gcloud artifacts generic upload and download, or any HTTP client against the REST upload and download endpoints; Docker clients for Docker-format repositories
chaining: projects do not multiply the allowance: the 0.5 GiB-month of free storage is counted once per billing account, across every project attached to it

limits.value: 0.5 GiB-month of storage free per billing account, shared across every attached project
60,000 requests and 18,000 write requests per minute per project in each region or multi-region

limits_note: storage above the free band is billed at USD 0.000136986 per GiB-hour, so the volume quota is a price threshold, not a hard stop

identity_cost.detail: the free tier needs a Google Cloud billing account; billing signup takes a credit card or other payment method, and in some countries a bank account verification

reliability_note: usage above the 0.5 GiB-month of free storage is billed at standard rates to the billing account, not stopped
confidence_note: every value was read on Google Cloud pages; no billing account was opened, so no value is measured

notes: Artifact Registry generic repositories hold versioned, immutable files of any format. The free tier is 0.5 GiB-month of storage per billing account; above it storage costs USD 0.000136986 per GiB-hour, and outbound internet transfer is billed at Premium Tier rates. The Cloud Storage Archive storage class is a separate product with its own pricing page.
binding_note: the 0.5 GiB-month of free storage per billing account is the whole free tier; every byte above it is billed
